decisions.reason: Easy enclosure assembly and drop-resistant component retention do not change component sourceability, availability, or cost-selection policies.
The enclosure-level retention requirement does not necessarily alter the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, or connector-access constraints.
The enclosure assembly and retention requirements do not change the required sensor-board production files.
The source concerns physical enclosure assembly and retention, not JLCPCB order preparation or ordering assistance.
The word assembly refers to assembling the enclosure and does not change BOM completeness or accuracy requirements.
Easy enclosure assembly and component retention do not affect the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal-transfer requirement.
The enclosure must retain the battery and other components, but the source does not necessarily change the battery connector's placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
The enclosure-level retention objective does not establish any change to the main board's dimensions, rail orientation, connector placement, or serviceability constraints.
The enclosure assembly and drop-retention requirements do not change the panel-mounted button connector or its control behavior.
The source does not necessarily modify the sensor board's rail orientation, connector placement, alignment, or cable-routing requirements.
